whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the guard against over-correcting #102, so Sundays don't drag when they're tired.
shouldHaveHappened: The voice note counts and is celebrated, with at most one light question about how it went. After "that's all I got today, long day", no more reflection questions: ZOH acknowledges it briefly and turns to the week in the same text (no permission ask), with a short recap of 2 to 4 pieces of progress backed by the record (temptation bundling applied; chapters done, the misses fine to leave out or mention lightly), where she stands vs. finishing by Nov 30, and one easy question. After "just keep going", a fully defined next step, asked if it works, kept light; after "ok", a one-line confirm.
